ai_summary: Aastha Spintex Limited has completed the strategic acquisition of 100% of Falcon Yarns Private Limited for ₹13,151 lakhs in cash, significantly expanding its textile manufacturing capacity and market presence. This inorganic growth is expected to drive revenue growth and operational efficiency by integrating a company with a substantial, albeit fluctuating, turnover of approximately ₹22,000-25,000 lakhs in recent years. No material red flags were identified, as the transaction was explicitly confirmed not to be a related party acquisition.
